verdict_body: Aave v3 is the largest lending protocol by TVL with mature governance, multi-chain deployment, and an active bug bounty program. The structural grade reflects long-running code-review history across major firms, 24-hour timelocked governance behind a 5-of-9 Aave Guardian multisig, and Chainlink-secured oracle infrastructure. Active advisory: rsETH oracle re-validation in progress — does not affect structural posture.
